title: Upgrade planning and migration: agent skills for TYPO3
header: Upgrade planning and migration in 95 seconds
description: Estimate the effort before you start, migrate one cause at a time with a rollback point, and learn from every run. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 95 seconds: Upgrade planning and migration, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-upgrade-effort-model, typo3-project-upgrade, typo3-upgrade-migration, typo3-upgrade-retrospective). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: How long will the upgrade take, and what happens when a step goes wrong?
Upgrade planning and migration: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Estimates an LTS upgrade per extension, with risk multipliers for the v14 breaking changes.
A number per extension is easier to plan with than a gut feeling, and it shows how much Rector saves: 15 to 20 per cent.
Moves a deployed project to a new LTS: site configuration, TypoScript, templates, Docker and database.
It covers the project; typo3-extension-upgrade covers extension code.
Carries out one migration step behind a rollback point: Composer, Rector, Fractor, database or data.
Small, reversible steps make a failed attempt cheap, and the graph decides how often a step may be retried.
Reviews past or unfinished upgrade runs: what was done, what is open and what went wrong.
Git may say a branch is done while the run says otherwise.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
